note: Mission 4 'The Hollow Throne' in-game lines (text only, not rendered yet). dur = slot in seconds. Line ids keep the ep1 numbering (L22 unused; L24-L26 new in mission-04.md). L1-L4 are the m4_war subtitles, L21 the m4_fall subtitle. Speakers: narrator, malrik, vessa, whisper, obren (alias of whisper), vey, pell (all already in cast.json; no new speaker ids).

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Crown Hollow. Where the Master once sat, two armies wait for the sun.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.text: Three relics, little ember. Hand them over and I'll let you keep the hat.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Come and take them, Bishop. You owe me for Emberfall. And for Vey.

lines.speaker: whisper
lines.text: Yes. Come, both of you. Fight on my roof.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.text: Yes. Fight. Every fallen soldier is a step on my stair.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: The ground is breathing. That can't be good.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.text: A hundred years in the dark. I had time to practise my entrance.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: I had ten minutes to practise running. Those pillars feed it. Break them all!

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.text: A giant made of rubble, in MY war? Shades, kill the pillars. Then kill Vessa.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Two down. Keep hitting the glowing parts. It's always the glowing parts.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.text: Enough. I will walk to your little fire and put it out myself.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.text: This body... cracks... No matter. Stone is patient.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Not the keep! I JUST had it redecorated!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Everyone, back to the keep! BACK!

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Stay close, girl. Whatever it throws at you, I'll ground it.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Crown, orb, signet. Let's see what you do together.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.text: His storm? Impossible! That light should have faded a hundred years ago!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Nobody stays faded around here. Ask Vey.

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: The spark was yours, Vessa. NOW the storm!

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Somebody... finish my war...

lines.speaker: obren
lines.text: The Hollow... remembers...

lines.speaker: vey
lines.text: Just resting my knees. Keep turning that key!

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.text: One pillar down. You're welcome, little ember. Don't get used to it.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.text: An old man and a thunderstorm. Shades, fall back. I'll collect whatever is left.

lines.speaker: pell
lines.text: Last stall before the end of the world! Everything must go. Including me, quickly.
